identity.kind: Nikon DSLR camera with two lenses

claims.evidence: photo 0 does not show readable lens labels/specs to confirm 18-55mm and 50mm.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the camera/lenses but does not prove cleanliness level, sensor condition, or that video/shutter works.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is not readable; price varies a lot by model (e.g., D3xxx vs D7xxx).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., D3300/D3400/D90/D7200) and the lens label(s) showing focal length.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case within the comparable set for an unknown/possibly lower-tier DSLR bundle (treat as not confirmed higher-end model).

risks.risk: Lens focal lengths may be different from claimed (18-55mm + 50mm) or one lens may be non-matching/low quality.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both lenses showing the printed focal length (e.g., '18-55mm' and '50mm') and mount compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic DSLR kit with uncertain lens specs (worst-case match to the cheapest comparable that still fits 'DSLR + 18-55'.)

risks.risk: Functionality not proven: shutter count/actuation, autofocus, image stabilization (if any), and video recording may be faulty.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip: camera powered on, live view, autofocus on a moving object, and recording a few seconds (with audio if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested for video and assume basic operation only (worst-case within the comparables).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: fungus/haze on lens elements, sensor dust, scratches, or missing accessories.
risks.proof: Ask for: (1) photo of lens front element close-up for haze/fungus, (2) photo of rear element, (3) photo of sensor/inside mirror box (with lens removed), (4) list of included accessories (battery, charger, caps).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case condition (assume may need cleaning and missing accessories).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon DSLR model name/number on the body (not just the Nikon logo).
Close-up photos of both lenses showing printed focal length/specs (18-55mm and 50mm) and lens mount markings.
Short test video clip: power on + live view + autofocus + recording for a few seconds.
Photos of lens front/rear elements (for fungus/haze) and a sensor/inside shot (lens removed).
Confirm included accessories: battery, charger, both lens caps, body cap, and any memory card.
response.reason: The photo confirms a Nikon DSLR with two lenses, but the exact camera model and the lens focal lengths (18-55mm and 50mm) are not readable, and functionality/condition for video is not provable from the single image. Without those, a safe worst-case price pick from the comparables isn’t reliable.
